# WolrdPulse
> Real-Time Cloud Telemetry & DevOps Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for AI Coding Agents.

## Summary
WolrdPulse is an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server streaming live cloud outages (AWS, Vercel, GitHub), DNS-over-HTTPS queries (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1), SSL/TLS certificate verification, and synthetic edge latency probes. It enables autonomous AI agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf) to verify live infrastructure health before writing or refactoring code.

## Endpoints
- Homepage: https://wolrdpulse.app
- Remote SSE Endpoint: https://wolrdpulse.app/sse
- Public MCP Info: https://wolrdpulse.app/api/mcp
- Cloud Status API: https://wolrdpulse.app/api/status
- DNS DoH API: https://wolrdpulse.app/api/dns?name={domain}&type={type}
- SSL Inspector API: https://wolrdpulse.app/api/ssl?domain={domain}
- Edge Latency Ping API: https://wolrdpulse.app/api/ping?url={url}

## Supported Languages (hreflang)
- English: https://wolrdpulse.app/en
- Arabic: https://wolrdpulse.app/ar
- French: https://wolrdpulse.app/fr
- German: https://wolrdpulse.app/de
- Russian: https://wolrdpulse.app/ru
- Chinese: https://wolrdpulse.app/zh
- Korean: https://wolrdpulse.app/ko
- Japanese: https://wolrdpulse.app/ja
- Spanish: https://wolrdpulse.app/es

## MCP Server Installation
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "worldpulse": {
      "url": "https://wolrdpulse.app/sse"
    }
  }
}
```
Or via CLI:
`npx -y github:Mealiclay01/wolrdpulse`
